title: Gentle Leg Warm-Up for Seniors (50 Seconds)
promise: 50 seconds to wake up your legs
description: A short, gentle warm-up for seniors. A sturdy chair is all you need.

segments.name: March in Place
segments.say: Let's start by marching in place. Gently lift your knees.

segments.name: Heel Raises
segments.instruction: Rise onto your toes, then lower slowly
segments.say: Hold your chair if you need it. Rise onto your toes, then lower slowly. Eight times.
